perks.name: Ambitious Assassin
perks.desc: Overflows the magazine based on the number of rapid kills before reloading.

perks.name: Overflow
perks.desc: Picking up Special or Heavy ammo automatically loads this weapon beyond normal capacity.

perks.name: Subsistence
perks.desc: Defeating targets partially reloads the magazine from reserves.

perks.name: Triple Tap
perks.desc: Rapidly landing precision hits will return one round to the magazine.

perks.name: Field Prep
perks.desc: Increases ammo generation. Faster reload, stow, and ready speed when you're crouching.

perks.name: Perfect Float
perks.desc: Being in combat for a moderate time increases airborne effectiveness and reduces flinch until you are out of combat.

perks.name: Hip-Fire Grip
perks.desc: Increases accuracy, stability, and precision hit targeting when firing from the hip.

perks.name: Collective Demolition
perks.desc:
Collecting an Elemental pickup or destroying a Tangle grants this weapon a stacking period of grenade energy generation on hit. Throwing a Tangle provides additional time.

Elemental pickups include [Solar]Firesprites, [Void]Void Breaches, [Arc]Ionic Traces, [Stasis]Stasis Shards, and [Strand]Strand Tangles.

perks.name: Fourth Time's the Charm
perks.desc: Rapidly landing precision hits will return two rounds to the magazine.

perks.name: Successful Warm-Up
perks.desc: Each final blow increases charge/draw speed.

perks.name: Demoralize
perks.desc: Precision final blows cause nearby targets to become weakened.

perks.name: Mega Kill Clip
perks.desc: Reloading after a final blow grants a period of increased damage. Additional final blows before reloading further increases the duration of the damage period.

perks.name: Butterfly
perks.desc: Aiming this weapon for a short period without firing causes your target to explode the next time you deal final blows. Timer resets when you stop aiming down sights.

perks.name: Reservoir Burst
perks.desc: When the battery is full, your next burst deals additional damage and causes enemies to explode on death.

perks.name: Frenzy
perks.desc: Being in combat for an extended time increases damage, handling, and reload for this weapon until you are out of combat.

perks.name: Adagio
perks.desc: After defeating a target, this weapon fires, charges, or draws more slowly and deals increased damage for a brief time.

perks.name: Discord
perks.desc: Final blows with another weapon grant this weapon increased speed for aiming down sights, accuracy, and airborne effectiveness for a short time. When Discord is active, final blows refund ammo.

perks.name: Chain Reaction
perks.desc: Each final blow with this weapon creates an elemental damage explosion.

perks.name: Withering Gaze
perks.desc: Aiming this weapon for a short period of time without firing grants the ability to weaken the next target. Timer resets after firing or when you stop aiming down sights.

perks.name: Successful Warm-Up
perks.desc: Each final blow increases charge/draw speed.

perks.name: Sword Logic
perks.desc: Final blows with this weapon grant bonus damage. The strength and duration of the bonus increases when more powerful targets are defeated.

perks.name: Precision Instrument
perks.desc: Dealing sustained damage increases precision damage.

perks.name: Elemental Honing
perks.desc: Dealing unique elemental damage grants this weapon a stacking damage bonus. This bonus is increased for kinetic weapons.

perks.name: Willing Vessel
perks.desc: Dealing damage or defeating targets with this weapon gradually grants increased stability, handling, reload speed, and charge rate. This effect gradually decreases over time but is gained more quickly while near allies.

perks.name: Runneth Over
perks.desc: Reloading near allies overflows the magazine. Bows receive faster draw time and Swords receive faster charge rate.

perks.name: Heretical Behavior
perks.desc: Sustained weapon damage or final blows versus powerful targets grant this weapon bonus reload, handling, and damage versus combatants. Gain this bonus immediately for a longer duration when you are revived.

notes: Constructed by @Adamsdown_Boy (PvE PvE-Boss PvE-SustainedDamage PvE-EndGame PvP-God M+KB Controller): First-choice PvE roll for sustained DPS against a single yellow-bar target in activities rated Normal, Hard or Very Hard difficulty, particularly on Prismatic builds. Eyes Unveiled is a precision linear fusion rifle, which are rated B-Tier for endgame PvE by @TheAegisRelic tiering spreadsheet https://linktr.ee/TheAegisRelic for "total damage standout, notable for solo due to less reliance on reload/Div vs. A499 and Particle access". The frame intrinsic offers built in Anti-Barrier, and a ×0.9 reduction in horizontal recoil as per the https://www.destiny2.science/ Destiny Data Compendium. The stats are decent by comparison with its peers - you can see them at https://destiny.report/w/4147428506/eyes-unveiled and hopefully https://d2foundry.gg/w/4147428506 will show how weapon stats impact in-game performance when the site is back up and running. With precision frames, you need to worry less about recoil control so look to improve Handling or maybe Stability. As the battery perk, Accelerated Coils improves charge time by 40ms at the cost of ×0.98 base damage, or Enhanced Battery gets you to the max 7 shots. For sustained boss damage, in the first trait perk column, Fourth Time's the Charm generates 2 shots from thin air after 4 crits within 2s (3s when enhanced) of each other - that's 10 shots from a battery of 6, or 11 from a battery of 7, with 4 of them free. Less ammo efficient, but also good is Overflow which refills the battery and boosts its capacity to ×2 of base (×2.2 when enhanced), rounded up, on picking up an ammo brick. In the second column, for damage on a Prismatic build, Elemental Honing grants an escalating stack of damage up to an max ×1.35 for 20s (23s when enhanced) for each elemental damage type inflicted, which can be refreshed with a new damage type until you've run through all 5. The Heretical Behaviour origin trait is excellent for boss damage, proccing for a refreshable 8s after 4 hits within 3s or for for 21s after being revived (10s and 23s enhanced) to boost damage by ×1.08, and Handling and Reload Speed by +50 with a ×0.8 reload animation scalar. Alternatively The Willing Vessel origin trait generates up to 5 stacks of a slowly decaying buff on dealing damage and kills, to boost Stability, Handling and Reload Speed. If you're interested, the name connects to the theatrical framing and truth-revealing motifs of Episode: Heresy. Recommended MW: Charge Time, with a Backup Mag or Charge Time mod or your preferred choice to boost weapon stats, ammo generation, or elemental pickups for builds.

pandapaxxy (PvE / M+KB / Controller): "Eyes Unveiled looks to be a decent contender if you don't have any precision frame linear fusion rifles collecting dust in your vault. Overflow, Triple Tap, and Field Prep are all ways to get ammo, either by doubling the magazine, giving ammo back, or holding more in reserves. Reservoir Burst also gives you extra damage and some AoE splash damage on the first (or overflowed) shot. Frenzy gives bonus damage on every shot after it activates, and Chain Reaction gives a lot of explosions. Pick your poison and pair it with the best alternate column." Recommended MW: Charge Time.

pandapaxxy (PvP / M+KB / Controller): "Linear fusions in PvP haven't been the most meta choice. They have a charge time. They need to be aimed. They're less ideal than a point and click-in-their-general-direction weapon like a rocket or grenade launcher. That's just how it goes. Withering Gaze is phenomenal for the times when you hit a limb or a torso instead of their head allowing you or your teammates a very easy follow up kill. Unfortunately there's absolutely nothing to aid Withering Gaze. Even Perfect Float is the best we have and that's mid at best." Recommended MW: Range or Charge Time.

Inspired by @PodvsEnemies episode 129 from 4 February 2024 (https://open.spotify.com/episode/19eFPPXbMv7cC0w8kJ234H?si=d61c9144b9aa4974) with @Saint_Kabr, @ImpetusAlways and @CourtProjects (PvE PvE-Boss PvE-BossSpec PvE-EndGame PvE-God M+KB Controller): First-choice PvE pick for sustained Boss damage in general, and end-game underleveled content. Eyes Unveiled is a decent option if you don't already have a crafted Taipan but if you do, you can safely pass. At base, the stats are a bit low - 35 Range, 52 Stability is ×1.1360 flinch resist at 100 Resilience, 25 Handling is 0.46s ready, 0.37s ADS and 0.37s stow speed, 18 Reload Speed is a 2.53s reload and Recoil Direction is 59. The mag size is 5 (max 7), and with 0/1/2/3 reserves mods total ammo is 24/26/27/28 (max 28). Use the barrel perk to add Handling and help control recoil to land crits easier, while the battery perk can be used to increase magazine size or speed up Charge Time. For sustained damage, Overflow in the first trait column doubles the number of shots you for just picking up an ammo brick, bypassing reload altogether. In the second, Reservoir Burst boosts battery size further, applies ×1.25 damage on overflowed shots and creates an AoE detonation on a kill. Willing Vessel passively increases Stability, Handling and Reload Speed for dealing damage (as well as on a kill too), particularly when you're in a fireteam, which is always useful. Recommended MW: Handling or Reload Speed, with a Backup Mag mod. Also, don't forget to check whether there's a useful Seasonal Fragile mod for the activity you're running.
